title: (Machine) Learning to Be Like Thee? For Algorithm Education, Not Training

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation through literature review and case studies of real-world AI failures, such as Amazon's discarded AI recruiting tool and misogynistic chatbot outputs (e.g., Microsoft Tay).

Qualitative evaluation through literature review and case studies of real-world AI applications, including healthcare risk prediction algorithms favoring white patients and predictive policing systems disproportionately targeting Black men.
